2610.07708.title: Evidence Before Sampling: Interpretable Implicit Negative Candidate Discovery for Recommendation
2610.07708.paper_summary: Recommender systems learn from observed user-item interactions, but explicit negative feedback is often unavailable. Since deep learning models require negative signals for training, negative sampling methods typically treat selected unobserved interactions as negatives. However, a missing interaction does not explain why a user is uninterested in an item or whether there is sufficient evidence to label it negative. This is especially important in business recommendation, where negative signals should be interpretable and aligned with business objectives. We formulate implicit negative candidate discovery to identify unobserved interactions supported by observed customer behavior. We encode these patterns as symbolic rules, score them based on support, informativeness, and product relevance, and rank the retained rules by evidence. An LLM then interprets the retained rules using business objectives and domain knowledge; the interpretations are combined with the statistical evidence in the final report. We evaluate our method in an industrial B2B setting and across five public recommendation datasets. Candidate-quality evaluations in the industrial setting and three public datasets show higher precision than the evaluated baselines, while symbolic selection improves downstream test PR-AUC by 12.5% over random selection with four negatives per positive example in the industrial task. Our results show that negative candidate validity can be evaluated separately from downstream recommendation performance. This distinction enables evidence-based, business-aligned, and explainable negative selection, improving both interpretability and model training in sparse, skewed, real-world recommendation settings.
2610.07708.paper_summary_zh: 推薦系統從觀察到的用戶-項目互動中學習，但明確的負面反饋通常不可用。由於深度學習模型需要負面信號進行訓練，負面抽樣方法通常將選定的未觀察互動視為負面。然而，缺失的互動並不能解釋為什麼用戶對某項目不感興趣，或是否有足夠的證據將其標記為負面。這在商業推薦中尤其重要，因為負面信號應該是可解釋的，並且與商業目標一致。我們制定了隱式負面候選發現，以識別由觀察到的客戶行為支持的未觀察互動。我們將這些模式編碼為符號規則，根據支持度、信息量和產品相關性對其進行打分，並根據證據對保留的規則進行排名。然後，LLM 使用商業目標和領域知識解釋保留的規則；這些解釋與最終報告中的統計證據相結合。我們在一個工業 B2B 環境和五個公共推薦數據集上評估我們的方法。在工業環境和三個公共數據集中的候選質量評估顯示出比評估的基準更高的精確度，而符號選擇在工業任務中將隨機選擇的每個正例四個負例的下游測試 PR-AUC 提高了 12.5%。我們的結果顯示，負面候選的有效性可以與下游推薦性能分開評估。這一區別使基於證據的、與商業對齊的、可解釋的負面選擇成為可能，改善了稀疏、偏斜的現實世界推薦環境中的可解釋性和模型訓練。
